name: George A. Kantor
title: Research Professor; Associate Director of Education
fitReason: Beyond agricultural robotics, WARPED provides a direct 2026 learning-from-human-video match: vision foundation models and Gaussian splatting convert demonstrations into wrist-view data for diffusion-policy training. A separate September 2026 policy-calibrated DAgger study concerns imitation-learning robustness but its reported tests are simulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: WARPED (April 2026 preprint, author reports CoRL 2026 acceptance) executes learned policies on a UFactory xArm7 with G1 gripper and wrist-mounted GoPro. It evaluates five tabletop tasks, using 30 human demonstrations and 20 physical evaluation trials per task at 10 Hz. First author Harry Freeman explicitly identifies Kantor as adviser, and the official faculty page corroborates group association.

shortVisit.summary: The lab invites people to attend a weekly lab meeting. That is not an external research appointment or summer internship invitation. No explicit current external-master’s short-visit recruitment was verified, so the opportunity score remains zero.

unknowns: WARPED’s faster human data collection does not imply equally faster total processing: its appendix reports roughly seven minutes of automated processing per demonstration plus per-task preparation. It assumes rigid tabletop objects and task-dependent starting positions with objects visible and near the gripper.
The September 2026 DAgger paper’s photorealistic engine-lever and planar-reacher evaluations are simulated, not additional hardware proof.
Prior agricultural harvesting papers and current university field-robot news support the broader lab context, but should not be substituted for proof of a summer opening.
The existing CMU overseas-degree Student Intern route still requires host and department approval; its institutional funding rules do not guarantee an individual placement.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
